package.description: A small coding agent for the terminal

en-US.description: A small coding agent for the terminal
en-US.longDescription:
anchor is a coding agent for the terminal. One model works in one directory through a handful
of tools, and a deterministic harness decides what it may touch: writes and most shell commands
ask first, secret files and dangerous commands are always denied, and secret values are masked
in command output. It works with Claude and any OpenAI-compatible API.
en-US.name: anchor
